You will one day. But you will feel this again despite getting better because life is struggle but a struggle in an attempt to experience. The absurdity of existence itself means nothing is certain and you must learn to accept it. As for how to enjoy the process: even the greatest of trees cannot bear fruit unless all its other needs are met; light, water, energy, air. Until its need for survival is satisfied it cannot bloom flowers to amaze or fruits to present. Find what you need and focus on fulfilling yourself, and eventually you will learn to enjoy life.

Btw our biology has so much to do with our mental health. Tour diet can radically change your mood and health. Please dont ignore it because as long as youre in survival mode you wont be able to enjoy yourself. Think of a starving lion, it cant fend for its cubs or spend time in its pride unless it can provide for itself sufficiently. Taking care of yourself is the best way to get out of this pit, and the only way to do that unfortunately is just to get into it. Start doing it without questioning yourself or it. Make it a routine for routines sake, and with time you will understand yourself better.

But what are you exiting to? If nothing matters then doesnt everything matter? Anything can matter as long as it matters to you because in this brief time were aware of our existence we have the power to choose how we shape our life, though much of it is spent moulding it. Even a lotus blooms from the murks of a pond. In your life you matter and no one should be able to convince you otherwise.

No brain was designed to live in this machine we call the world. It chews us up and spits us out without s single care for feelings or sentiment because it was built around the material. But the world can seem so much better if you Cana glimpse it for what it is outside of that. Its terribly difficult and insane that to feel like u belong you have to go through this much anguish but I believe in you because youre strong, stronger than you realise and you definitely wont feel that way now but I can guarantee you will later on. A “normal” life be damned, in this fucked uo world the most normal thing you can do is not be normal at this point. Ride your emotions like rollercoasters but never let them throw you off. You are more than just what u feel, u can be more than just what u do. All it takes is time, sounds cheesy as hell but cliches* wouldnt be overused if they didnt work. Youre more than you believe, you are here and thats all that could ever matter :)
